text: The Bermuda Tourism Authority (BTA) is the island's official destination marketing organisation, a quasi-independent tourism enterprise that partners with the Government of Bermuda.
short: BTA is Bermuda's official destination marketing organisation

source.name: Go To Bermuda: Bermuda Tourism Authority
source.quote: The Bermuda Tourism Authority (BTA) is the island's official destination marketing organisation, a dynamic, quasi-independent, and entrepreneurial tourism enterprise
